request.query: Every finite set of integers has its gcd as a linear combination

items.name: Int.gcd_least_linear
items.type: ∀ {a b : ℤ}, a ≠ 0 → IsLeast {n | 0 < n ∧ ∃ x y, ↑n = a * x + b * y} (a.gcd b)

items.name: Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
items.type: ∀ (x y : ℤ), ↑(x.gcd y) = x * x.gcdA y + y * x.gcdB y

items.name: Tactic.NormNum.int_gcd_helper'
items.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} (a b : ℤ), ↑d ∣ x → ↑d ∣ y → x * a + y * b = ↑d → x.gcd y = d

items.name: Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
items.type: ∀ (x y : ℕ), ↑(x.gcd y) = ↑x * x.gcdA y + ↑y * x.gcdB y

items.name: exists_gcd_eq_mul_add_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R),
  ∃ x y, gcd a b = a * x + b * y
